mostWorthwhile.text: Recovering iron from worn red blood cells and using it to make replacements was most worthwhile. It connected recycling to something the body needs to keep doing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the two finished processes to the body felt somewhat repetitive after seeing how each worked, though the final picture brought them together.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some original-looking cells remained in the marrow while new red cells entered the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The chapter explained that marrow could reuse iron, and the skin pictures showed how the layers fit together.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: seeing old cell material reused and new skin replace shedding cells made the body's ongoing changes interesting.
